title: An Ecopath with Ecosim model of the Western and Central Pacific Ocean warm-pool pelagic ecosystem
loadability_class: D — readable source recovered; reconstruction not audited
quality_rationale: Newly recovered readable source; full parameter and diet completeness has not been audited. Provisional loadability 20/55, documentation 10/20; geographic and recency components retained. Bibliographic/spatial correction:  Primary WCPFC landing lists downloadable SC3_EB_IP8.pdf. Bounds explicitly 110–180°E and 15°N–15°S; not blanket western-central Pacific EEZ coverage. Primary 42-page 2007 report Section 2.2 explicitly states fixed 110–180 E,15 N–15 S; Section 2.3 states 31 final functional groups. Do not conflate with later 44-group 140–180 E/10 N–15 S warm-pool models. Report includes parameter, diet and catch tables; no native model file verified.
download_attempt_summary: 2 actual retrieval requests logged in this project.
recommendation: Single preferred model for HS_071; oceanic pelagic focus aligns with the high-seas target.
geometry_note: Warm-pool pelagic domain used as the best available proxy for the Western Central Pacific high-seas unit.
